body_lead: Sridhar Babu noted that Aiden AI employs around 500 professionals and announced that the company planned to create employment opportunities for another 500 talented individuals over the next two years. Hyderabad: IT and industries minister D. Sridhar Babu stated that the robust ecosystem developed by the government over the last two years had led to globally renowned companies now looking towards Telangana for growth and investment. He was speaking on Thursday after inaugurating the expansion of the Aiden AI Engineering Centre at Hitec City.
